entities.summary: Georg Wolfgang Franz Panzer was a German medical doctor, botanist and entomologist. He produced a book on the insect fauna of Germany, illustrated with hand-coloured plates by Jacob Sturm which was produced in 109 parts over a 17 year period beginning in 1796.
